app.admin.note: Cookie and settings (UID / server / device info) are stored only in install-level private data readable by admins. Using a dedicated alt account is recommended. Record APIs (stamina/characters/endgame) require ltoken or ltoken_v2, which QR login fills in automatically; cookies with only cookie_token can read the miHoYo profile only.
